description: Manage browser and Electron app tabs/windows (open, switch, close, list). Specify 'app' when targeting desktop apps (e.g. app: 'discord') to avoid opening web browser.

action.description: Action to perform. 'consolidate' deduplicates tabs. 'heal' recovers crashed tabs.

app.description: Optional Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

force.description: Force close protected (anchor) tabs. Use with extreme caution.

reuse.description: Default true. When opening a URL already loaded in another tab, focus that tab instead of opening a duplicate.

tabIds.description: Multiple Tab IDs for batch 'close' action.

name: browser_tabs
